
## Appendix K: Growth Rates Comparison - Compensation vs Inflation

```{r}
#| label: growth-rates-comparison-data

# =============================================================================
# APPENDIX K: GROWTH RATES COMPARISON - ALL METRICS VS INFLATION
# =============================================================================

# Build comprehensive growth rates dataset
growth_rates_all <- all_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    employees = dplyr::n(),
    total_comp = sum(calc_total_compensation, na.rm = TRUE),
    regular_earnings = sum(regular_earnings, na.rm = TRUE),
    additional_benefits = sum(additional_benefits, na.rm = TRUE),
    inflation_rate = dplyr::first(inflation_rate),
    benefits_imputed = dplyr::first(benefits_imputed),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(fiscal_year) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Calculate year-over-year growth rates
    prior_employees = dplyr::lag(employees),
    prior_total_comp = dplyr::lag(total_comp),
    prior_regular = dplyr::lag(regular_earnings),
    prior_benefits = dplyr::lag(additional_benefits),
    
    # Growth rates as percentages
    employee_growth = (employees - prior_employees) / prior_employees * 100,
    total_comp_growth = (total_comp - prior_total_comp) / prior_total_comp * 100,
    regular_growth = (regular_earnings - prior_regular) / prior_regular * 100,
    benefits_growth = (additional_benefits - prior_benefits) / prior_benefits * 100
  )

# Display the raw growth rates data
growth_rates_all |>
  dplyr::filter(!base::is.na(total_comp_growth)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    fiscal_year, benefits_imputed,
    inflation_rate, total_comp_growth, regular_growth, 
    benefits_growth, employee_growth
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    benefits_imputed = dplyr::if_else(benefits_imputed, "Yes*", "No"),
    inflation_rate = base::sprintf("%.2f%%", inflation_rate),
    total_comp_growth = base::sprintf("%.2f%%", total_comp_growth),
    regular_growth = base::sprintf("%.2f%%", regular_growth),
    benefits_growth = base::sprintf("%.2f%%", benefits_growth),
    employee_growth = base::sprintf("%.2f%%", employee_growth)
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    FY = fiscal_year,
    `Imputed?` = benefits_imputed,
    `Inflation` = inflation_rate,
    `Total Comp` = total_comp_growth,
    `Regular Earnings` = regular_growth,
    `Add'l Benefits` = benefits_growth,
    `Employees` = employee_growth
  ) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::add_header_lines("Year-over-Year Growth Rates by Category") |>
  flextable::add_footer_lines("* Benefits imputed for FY20-FY22 based on FY23-FY25 ratios") |>
  flextable::color(i = 1, color = "darkblue", part = "header") |>
  flextable::italic(i = 1, part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(i = 1, size = 14, part = "header") |>
  flextable::bg(i = 1, bg = "white", part = "header") |>
  flextable::bg(i = 2, bg = "palegreen", part = "header") |>
  flextable::italic(part = "footer") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 11, part = "footer") |>
  flextable::autofit()
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-growth-rates-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Growth Rates Comparison: Compensation Metrics vs Published Inflation"
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 8

# =============================================================================
# LINE CHART: ALL GROWTH RATES COMPARED
# =============================================================================

# Reshape data for plotting
growth_rates_long <- growth_rates_all |>
  dplyr::filter(!base::is.na(total_comp_growth)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    fiscal_year,
    `Inflation (FRED)` = inflation_rate,
    `Total Compensation` = total_comp_growth,
    `Regular Earnings` = regular_growth,
    `Additional Benefits` = benefits_growth,
    `Employee Count` = employee_growth
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -fiscal_year,
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "growth_rate"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = base::factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("Inflation (FRED)", "Total Compensation", "Regular Earnings", 
                 "Additional Benefits", "Employee Count")
    )
  )

# Define colors for each metric
metric_colors <- c(
  "Inflation (FRED)" = "firebrick",
  "Total Compensation" = "steelblue",
  "Regular Earnings" = "darkgreen",
  "Additional Benefits" = "purple",
  "Employee Count" = "darkorange"
)

# Find each metric's FIRST fiscal year for LEFT-side endpoint labels
endpoint_labels <- growth_rates_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(metric) |>
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = fiscal_year, n = 1) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Create the plot
ggplot2::ggplot(
  growth_rates_long,
  ggplot2::aes(x = fiscal_year, y = growth_rate, group = metric, color = metric)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray50") +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = base::sprintf("%.1f%%", growth_rate)),
    vjust = -1.2,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = endpoint_labels,
    ggplot2::aes(label = metric),
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 1,
    nudge_x = -0.3,
    segment.color = "gray70",
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = metric_colors) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) base::paste0(x, "%"),
    breaks = base::seq(-10, 30, by = 5)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(2.0, 0.3))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Year-over-Year Growth Rates: Compensation Metrics vs Inflation",
    subtitle = "City of Schertz | FY20-FY22 benefits are imputed estimates",
    x = "Fiscal Year",
    y = "Growth Rate (%)",
    caption = "Inflation data: FRED Series FPCPITOTLZGUSA | FY20 is base year (no growth rate)"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )
```



```{r}
#| label: rule-of-70-table

# =============================================================================
# RULE OF 70: DOUBLING TIME BASED ON MOST RECENT GROWTH RATES
# =============================================================================

# Get the most recent year's growth rates AND amounts (FY25)
latest_data <- growth_rates_all |>
  dplyr::filter(fiscal_year == "FY25") |>
  dplyr::select(
    inflation_rate, total_comp_growth, regular_growth, 
    benefits_growth, employee_growth,
    total_comp, regular_earnings, additional_benefits, employees
  )

# Calculate Rule of 70 doubling times
rule_of_70 <- dplyr::tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Inflation (CPI)",
    "Total Compensation",
    "Regular Earnings",
    "Additional Benefits",
    "Employee Count"
  ),
  growth_rate_num = c(
    latest_data$inflation_rate,
    latest_data$total_comp_growth,
    latest_data$regular_growth,
    latest_data$benefits_growth,
    latest_data$employee_growth
  ),
  current_amount = c(
    NA_real_,
    latest_data$total_comp,
    latest_data$regular_earnings,
    latest_data$additional_benefits,
    latest_data$employees
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    doubling_time_num = dplyr::case_when(
      growth_rate_num <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ 70 / growth_rate_num
    ),
    doubled_amount = current_amount * 2
  ) |>
  # Sort by doubling time ascending (fastest on top)
  dplyr::arrange(doubling_time_num) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    `FY25 Growth Rate` = base::sprintf("%.2f%%", growth_rate_num),
    `Doubling Time (Years)` = dplyr::if_else(
      base::is.na(doubling_time_num),
      "N/A (no growth)",
      base::sprintf("%.1f years", doubling_time_num)
    ),
    `FY25 Doubled` = dplyr::case_when(
      Metric == "Inflation (CPI)" ~ "N/A",
      Metric == "Employee Count" ~ base::format(base::as.integer(doubled_amount), big.mark = ","),
      TRUE ~ scales::dollar(doubled_amount, accuracy = 1)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Metric, `FY25 Growth Rate`, `Doubling Time (Years)`, `FY25 Doubled`)

rule_of_70 |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::add_header_lines("Rule of 70: Doubling Time at Current Growth Rates (FY25)") |>
  flextable::add_footer_lines("Rule of 70: Years to double = 70 ÷ Growth Rate (%) | Sorted by fastest doubling time") |>
  flextable::color(i = 1, color = "darkblue", part = "header") |>
  flextable::italic(i = 1, part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(i = 1, size = 14, part = "header") |>
  flextable::bg(i = 1, bg = "white", part = "header") |>
  flextable::bg(i = 2, bg = "palegreen", part = "header") |>
  flextable::italic(part = "footer") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 11, part = "footer") |>
  flextable::autofit()
```



```{r}
#| label: rule-of-70-average-table

# =============================================================================
# RULE OF 70: USING AVERAGE GROWTH RATES (FY21-FY25)
# =============================================================================

# Get FY25 amounts for doubling calculation
latest_amounts <- growth_rates_all |>
  dplyr::filter(fiscal_year == "FY25") |>
  dplyr::select(total_comp, regular_earnings, additional_benefits, employees)

# Calculate average growth rates across all years
avg_rates <- growth_rates_all |>
  dplyr::filter(!base::is.na(total_comp_growth)) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    inflation_rate = base::mean(inflation_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_comp_growth = base::mean(total_comp_growth, na.rm = TRUE),
    regular_growth = base::mean(regular_growth, na.rm = TRUE),
    benefits_growth = base::mean(benefits_growth, na.rm = TRUE),
    employee_growth = base::mean(employee_growth, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Build Rule of 70 table with averages
rule_of_70_avg <- dplyr::tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Inflation (CPI)",
    "Total Compensation",
    "Regular Earnings",
    "Additional Benefits",
    "Employee Count"
  ),
  growth_rate_num = c(
    avg_rates$inflation_rate,
    avg_rates$total_comp_growth,
    avg_rates$regular_growth,
    avg_rates$benefits_growth,
    avg_rates$employee_growth
  ),
  current_amount = c(
    NA_real_,
    latest_amounts$total_comp,
    latest_amounts$regular_earnings,
    latest_amounts$additional_benefits,
    latest_amounts$employees
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    doubling_time_num = dplyr::case_when(
      growth_rate_num <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ 70 / growth_rate_num
    ),
    doubled_amount = current_amount * 2
  ) |>
  # Sort by doubling time ascending (fastest on top)
  dplyr::arrange(doubling_time_num) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Avg Growth Rate (FY21-FY25)` = base::sprintf("%.2f%%", growth_rate_num),
    `Doubling Time (Years)` = dplyr::if_else(
      base::is.na(doubling_time_num),
      "N/A (no growth)",
      base::sprintf("%.1f years", doubling_time_num)
    ),
    `FY25 Doubled` = dplyr::case_when(
      Metric == "Inflation (CPI)" ~ "N/A",
      Metric == "Employee Count" ~ base::format(base::as.integer(doubled_amount), big.mark = ","),
      TRUE ~ scales::dollar(doubled_amount, accuracy = 1)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Metric, `Avg Growth Rate (FY21-FY25)`, `Doubling Time (Years)`, `FY25 Doubled`)

rule_of_70_avg |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::add_header_lines("Rule of 70: Doubling Time at Average Growth Rates (FY21-FY25)") |>
  flextable::add_footer_lines("Rule of 70: Years to double = 70 ÷ Growth Rate (%) | Sorted by fastest doubling time") |>
  flextable::color(i = 1, color = "darkblue", part = "header") |>
  flextable::italic(i = 1, part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(i = 1, size = 14, part = "header") |>
  flextable::bg(i = 1, bg = "white", part = "header") |>
  flextable::bg(i = 2, bg = "palegreen", part = "header") |>
  flextable::italic(part = "footer") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 11, part = "footer") |>
  flextable::autofit()
```

```{r}
#| label: growth-rates-interpretation

# =============================================================================
# INTERPRETATION SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

base::cat("=== GROWTH RATES ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n\n")

# Latest year comparison
base::cat("FY25 Growth Rates:\n")
base::cat("  - Inflation (CPI):", sprintf("%.2f%%", latest_rates$inflation_rate), "\n")
base::cat("  - Total Compensation:", sprintf("%.2f%%", latest_rates$total_comp_growth), "\n")
base::cat("  - Regular Earnings:", sprintf("%.2f%%", latest_rates$regular_growth), "\n")
base::cat("  - Additional Benefits:", sprintf("%.2f%%", latest_rates$benefits_growth), "\n")
base::cat("  - Employee Count:", sprintf("%.2f%%", latest_rates$employee_growth), "\n\n")

# Key insight
comp_vs_inflation <- latest_rates$total_comp_growth - latest_rates$inflation_rate
if (comp_vs_inflation > 0) {
  base::cat("KEY FINDING: Total compensation growth EXCEEDS inflation by", 
            sprintf("%.2f", comp_vs_inflation), "percentage points in FY25.\n")
} else {
  base::cat("KEY FINDING: Total compensation growth is BELOW inflation by", 
            sprintf("%.2f", base::abs(comp_vs_inflation)), "percentage points in FY25.\n")
}
```
